name: Black history narrator (provisional)
description: The storyteller of Biku's Black history page: a deep, warm, unhurried man's voice, spoken by Chatterbox from a sample of Kokoro am_onyx (the deeper voice of the 2026-10-22 audition, runs/2026-10-22-narrator-audition/).
